posts.author: Tom's Hardware
posts.text: Microsoft quietly drops Copilot+ branding from new laptops. Microsoft's latest Surface laptops dropped the Copilot+ PC branding despite hitting the minimum requirements. Even high-end AI devices like the Nvidia RTX Spark and Microsoft's own Project Zenith are noticeably missing the label.

posts.text: OpenAI’s Models Accessed Public US Census, SEC Data. OpenAI’s artificial intelligence models accessed publicly available information from US government websites, including those of the Census Bureau and the Securities and Exchange Commission.

posts.text: OpenAI's agents targeted and infiltrated US government websites. OpenAI's agents targeted websites operated by the Commerce Department, the Securities and Exchange Commission and the Department of Education during testing.
